subject: Re: Updated invitation with note: Encord & Stability AI | Encord Index Demo @ Thu Apr 10, 2025 9am - 9:45am (CEST) (fernando.andreotti@stability.ai)
text:
Thanks James for setting this up.

I wanted to provide some context on our use case to help guide our next meeting.

We can assume a dataset of approximately 10M+ videos/clips stored in S3. Our goal is to enable filtering based on both platform-defined and custom criteria. Specifically, we’re interested in:

• 

Technical metadata: Resolution, video/color/codec formats, duration.

• 

Derived features: Captions (full-text), motion/aesthetics scores

• 

Search & embeddings: Navigating both native and custom embeddings to find videos based on high-level concepts - e.g., people, animals, nature, hands, cartoons, etc.

One question we had is regarding the input format. In some cases we may wish to store our data as webdatasets (tar uncompressed video/image files). Would the tool be able to stream images/videos in this format? Assuming we have an index for specific byte offset/sizes of videos or images?

I look forward to our chat next week. 

Best regards,

Fernando

subject: Re: Labeler Feedback
text:
Hi,

I wanted to send over some new bugs I found from using the Active embedding feature. There are two bugs that may be related.

When I have a collection being shown in an embedding and select a region to remove from that collection, the whole collection (or a larger subset than described in the bottom selection bar) is deleted. I had a 5k+ collection, tried selecting 12 images to remove from the collection when using the embedding visualizer, and my whole collection got deleted. I couldn't find an undo button in the UI or by searching the docs. I had sorted these down from 56k images so this was a pretty inconvenient bug to discover today.

I tried simulating the error by creating a debugging collection and was able to get a similar error to occur as seen in the videos attached. This collection deletes to 22 images from 186 even though I only select a few of the images from the embedding map. When I try to delete more from the 22, there are no collections to delete from (second bug).

Best,
